verdict.rationale: A registered-agent service could plausibly offer an API for retrieving received documents and their metadata, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party content: robots.txt returned a Cloudflare challenge, and nothing else on the site was fetched. The only community item mentions SEO and says nothing about any machine interface for documents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can retrieve received legal documents and their metadata through a documented machine interface, not only a human dashboard
